title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1982-09-18

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a beloved 1982 show with great energy despite minor imperfections.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate this performance highly, calling it one of their favorites and recalling an unforgettable first‑show experience. The recording is described as not perfect but still enjoyable, with no major technical complaints noted. Overall the concert conveys high excitement and a strong connection to the music.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 4‑star reviews highlight an excellent musical performance and a generally good soundboard recording, though no detailed technical analysis limits confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear soundboard source; reviewers note it isn’t perfect but mention no major drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; listeners focus on overall enjoyment.
